verse.verse_2: and ten nights (of pilgrimage or the last ten days of Ramadan),
verse.verse_3: by the even, and the odd,
verse.verse_4: by the night when it journeys on!
verse.verse_5: Is there in that an oath for the mindful?
verse.verse_6: Have you not heard how your Lord dealt with Aad?
verse.verse_8: the like of which was never created in the countries?
verse.verse_9: And Thamood, who hewed out the rocks of the valley?
verse.verse_10: And Pharaoh, of the pegs (impaling his victims)?
verse.verse_11: They were tyrants in the land
verse.verse_13: (Therefore) your Lord let loose upon them a scourge of punishment;
verse.verse_14: indeed, your Lord is ever watchful.
verse.verse_15: As for man, when his Lord tests him by honoring him and favoring him, he says: 'My Lord, has honored me'
verse.verse_16: But when He tests him by restricting his provision, he says: 'My Lord has humiliated me'
verse.verse_17: No! But you show no good to the orphan,
verse.verse_18: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy.
verse.verse_19: and you devour the inheritance with greed,
verse.verse_21: No! But when the earth quakes and is pounded,
verse.verse_22: and your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,
verse.verse_23: and Gehenna (Hell) is brought near on that Day the human will remember, and how shall the Reminder be for him?
verse.verse_24: He will say: 'Would that I had forwarded (good works) for my life!'
verse.verse_25: But on that Day none will punish as He (Allah) will punish,
verse.verse_26: nor will any bind as He binds.
verse.verse_28: return to your Lord wellpleased, wellpleasing.
